answer: Locks are recorded in timber, expire in grove, and relic lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 141 aliases therefore needs 84 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2629 identities would post 1761 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
